propers.text:
Mentes nostras, quaesumus, Domine, lumine tuae claritatis illustra: ut
videre possimus, quae agenda sunt; et, quae recta sunt, agere
valeamus. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: Enlighten our minds, we beseech Thee, O Lord, with the light of Thy brightness, that we may be able to see what things ought to be done and have strength to perform the things that are just. Through our Lord.
